newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Mudslide kills eight Pakistani soldiers.
newsitem.headline: Mudslide kills eight Pakistani soldiers.

text.p: Eight Pakistani soldiers were killed in their sleep and six injured when a mudslide caused by heavy rains engulfed their barracks, an army source said on Saturday.
The incident happened around midnight on Thursday in the Pakistan-controlled part of the disputed Kashmir region.
India rules two-thirds and Pakistan the rest of the Himalayan region, over which the countries have fought two of their three wars since their independence from Britain in 1947.
